text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All of Symboli Rudolf's races have<n>been run. She
has carried the dreams<n>of every Umamusume on
her back<n>and engraved the Emperor's name<n>into
the heart of all who watched her<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The words of gratitude she<n>exchanges with me ring
all the<n>sweeter for our shared efforts.
